title: Would not recommend
text:
Would not recommend. These are packets that have little yellow beads of air freshener in them
They supposedly work like a carpet deodorizer. You sprinkle them around your carpet, then vacuum them up. They are supposed to make your vacuum smell better as well.

First off, the little beads bounce. When I shook out the packet, they bounced everywhere, rather than just where I was spreading them. This is a problem, since we have pets. I had them locked up when I tried them, thankfully. But I couldn't just vacuum and be done. I had to check under every chair, floor lamp, box, bin, etc and flick little yellow beads of unknown contents back out into the middle of the floor to either be vacuumed back up or just thrown away.

Overall zero difference in scent or deodorizing, but created a lot of extra work for me. Cannot recommend these.
